capabilities: plan projects on a Gantt chart with phases, tasks, milestones, deadlines, key dates and locations
add items with one-line quick-add syntax that parses dates, durations, phases and progress
drag, resize, link and fold timeline bars, with a critical path and plan-versus-reality comparison
import plans from spreadsheets, CSV/TSV, Markdown tables, Mermaid gantt charts or plain lists
export the timeline as print-ready PDF, PNG, SVG, a Markdown table or CSV
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README includes quick-add syntax tables, a keyboard/mouse reference, and explains that timelines are plain YAML notes that keep working if the plugin is uninstalled.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to plan and visualize a project schedule on a timeline while keeping the plan as a plain Markdown note in the vault.
summary: Gantt chart planner that turns Markdown notes with YAML into timelines of phases, tasks, milestones and deadlines, with quick add and PDF export.
